data.title: Campaign Manager
data.description:
The Role

inPowered is seeking a highly skilled Ad Operations Manager. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in digital advertising operations, a deep understanding of ad tech platforms, and a proven track record of optimizing ad campaigns to maximize performance and ROI.
 

Responsibilities:
  • Campaign Management and Optimization: Oversee the end-to-end campaign execution process, from campaign setup to performance analysis and optimization. Monitor campaign performance metrics, analyze data, and implement optimization strategies to maximize ROI and achieve client objectives.
  • Ad Tech Platform Management: Manage and maintain relationships with ad tech vendors and platforms, ensuring seamless integration and implementation of new technologies. Stay updated on industry trends, new ad tech solutions, and best practices to drive innovation and efficiency in ad operations.
  • Quality Assurance and Compliance: Implement rigorous QA processes to ensure the accuracy and quality of ad placements, targeting, and tracking. Ensure compliance with industry regulations, privacy policies, and best practices related to digital advertising.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Develop and deliver regular performance reports and insights to clients and internal stakeholders, highlighting key metrics, trends, and opportunities for optimization. Utilize data analytics tools and platforms to extract valuable insights and inform strategic AI decision-making.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field.
  • 3+ years in an ad operations role, optimizing campaigns on various DSPs (The Trade Desk, DV360, Yahoo etc.)
  • Experience with driving performance for various KPIs such as CPPV, CPA, and ROAS.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (Pivot, Vlookup, etc.)
  • Knowledge of 3rd party verification solutions (DoubleVerify, Integral Ad Science, MOAT)
  • Knowledge of 3rd party ad servers and reporting (GCM, Sizmek, etc.)
  • Experience with project management applications (Jira, Asana, etc.)
  • Experience using Inspect Element/ Network Calls in browser to troubleshoot is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

data.title: Sales Director
data.description:
The Role
inPowered AI is seeking a driven and strategic Sales Director to join our fast-growing revenue team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of the agency landscape—particularly holding companies—and a proven track record of consultative sales and long-term client relationship building. You will play a key role in introducing inPowered’s sell-side AI capabilities to new agency partners and expanding existing relationships to drive consistent revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities:
Consistently achieve or exceed monthly revenue goals.
Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities across holding companies, independent agencies, and direct marketers.
Serve as a strategic consultant to clients, designing and delivering tailored programmatic activations in collaboration with inPowered’s solutions and customer success teams.
Build long-term account strategies to drive sustainable growth, respond to RFPs, and support upfront media planning and buying.
Generate a high volume of sales activity, including calls, meetings, presentations, proposals, and client engagements.
Establish and maintain senior-level relationships within agencies and brands; lead campaign ideation aligned to client business objectives.

Qualifications:
  • 4-5 years of experience in digital media sales, programmatic advertising, or ad tech.
  • Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem (SSPs, DSPs, and ad tech platforms), audience targeting, media optimization strategies, and data-driven brand storytelling.
  • Demonstrated success in consultative, solution-oriented sales.
  • Strong industry contacts and territory knowledge.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including compelling presentation abilities.
  • Ability to manage high volumes of outbound sales activity while maintaining strategic focus.
  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and CRM tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Compensation & Benefits:
  • Competitive base salary and commission structure
  • 100% employer-paid health benefits
  • Unlimited PTO policy
  • 401(k) plan offered
  • Monthly reimbursement for gym membership, home internet, and mobile phone

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote)
data.description:
The Role

We are seeking a brilliant engineer to help accelerate the build out of our client-facing content marketing platform. The candidate will be working closely with our teams to design and implement new systems, maintain operations of the production systems and to coordinate work across all the initiatives of the Engineering team. The candidate will operate in a distributed architecture building the infrastructure to manage Big Data and solve complex algorithmic problems. Will deliver initiatives that drive revenue and improve efficiency in line with our business strategy. Will maintain in-depth knowledge of the organization's technologies and architectures. Will develop and enforce best practices for master data management and development. The ideal candidate is a passionate developer with significant experience in designing and building complex systems. Capable of providing extraordinary output in terms of quantity and quality.


Responsibilities

  • Autonomously deliver key new features for our back-end systems
  • Improve performance, scalability, maintainability, and flexibility of our back-end systems
  • Deliver code in an agile team environment
  • Drive innovation through rapid prototyping and iterative development
  • Participate in development life cycle activities - design, code, test and release


Requirements:

  • 6+ years’ experience in Java
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Experience creating complex projects, regarding architecture and development
  • Ability to work independently and with teams
  • Extensive experience with Service Oriented Architectures
  • Solid experience with SQL and noSQL database solutions
  • Experience on tools like Spark, Kafka, and Clickhouse
  • Familiarity with AWS and Docker
  • Strong analytical skills
